help: the PR read first, then the standing forge report, then the acts, then the checkout's own state: an unresolvable argument or anything but MERGEABLE stops it before the report, refuse-class drift stops it before anything irreversible, the head is rebased onto the PR's own base and gated before it is force-pushed, the squash lands pinned to the head that rebase produced, this checkout converges on the merge commit the forge names, what the merge orphaned is swept by prune --apply, and the last word is the checkout's own state (git status --short --branch) — no message flags, so the body is assembled from the branch's commits and keeps their signatures

args.name: pr
args.help: the PR to merge: a number, a URL, or a branch

sends: gh pr view — reads the PR's base, head branch and mergeability before anything else, its head after the rebase, and the merge commit after the squash
git fetch origin <base> <head> — reads both refs before the rebase
git push --force-with-lease — WRITES the rebased head back to the PR (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
gh pr merge --squash — WRITES the merge (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
git push origin --delete — prune --apply, sweeping the server branches this merge and its siblings left (refused loudly under YOGA_NO_SEND)
git fetch origin — reads the squash back so the base can fast-forward
